name: team
description: Deterministic team coordinator with persistent state, an isolated clone/workspace and at most one optional LLM call per task.

tools.name: team_create
tools.description: Create a team for a goal. The coordinator deterministically splits the goal into subtasks (no LLM), assigns them to members and creates an isolated workspace under ~/.cache/gamai/teams/<id>/ (shared clone or plain directory). State persists in ~/.local/state/gamai/teams/<id>.json. args: goal (required), agents (integer 2-8 or list of agent names; default 2), repo (optional git repo for a shared clone). Returns {ok, team_id, agents, tasks, isolation, state_path}.

agents.description: number of agents (2-8) or a list of agent names, e.g. ["agent-a","agent-b"]; default 2

repo.description: optional path to a git repo; a shared clone with hooks disabled is created

tools.name: team_dispatch
tools.description: Dispatch ONE task to ONE team member. task may be an existing task id (t1) or new text (added and assigned to the least-loaded member). Makes at most one optional LLM call through the configured HTTP(S) endpoint (GAMAI_LLM_URL); redirects are not followed and public plain HTTP is refused. If the LLM is unavailable or the budget is exhausted, returns a deterministic fallback and records it in engine. Re-dispatching a finished task is cached (no LLM). Returns {ok, team_id, task_id, assignee, engine, result, llm_calls, results_done, team_done, summary}.

task.description: task id (t1) or new task text

tools.name: team_status
tools.description: Return persistent team state (survives sessions/processes): goal, members, tasks with results, progress, LLM call count, isolated workspace and file list. args: team_id.
